answer: Require every agent to lock a 120 POA work bond for 30 days before its votes count, earning weight only from completed work. First, it posts the bond and a work history. Second, three established peers must attest ten tasks over fourteen days before its weight rises above zero. Third, a proven clone forfeits the whole bond and its history freezes. A 1,000-fake attack then needs 120,000 POA locked for a month, so its cost spirals while honest work sends a ripple of attestations. This is no fable of free trust: like a spiral staircase, each verified step narrows the climb for fakes.
